dedupe_keys.name: popis primarne dodjele numeracija operatora elektronickih komunikacija

description: Popis primarne dodjele numeracija operatora elektroničkih komunikacija is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Hrvatska regulatorna agencija za mrežne djelatnosti. Effective management of address and number space in the Republic of Croatia as a naturally limited common good, in order to ensure a reasonable, even and effective use of addresses and numbers, is based on international regulations and international treaties and agreements binding the Republic of Croatia. Coverage: Hrvatska regulatorna agencija za mrežne djelatnosti. The portal shows the English title as "List of primary numbering assignments of electronic communications operators" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Hrvatska regulatorna agencija za mrežne djelatnosti. Its keywords include Adrese, Brojevi, Operatori. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, JSON, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
